\section{Method}
We use merge sort, which runs in $O(n \log n)$ time in the worst case.
\begin{equation}
  T(n) = 2T(n/2) + \Theta(n)
\end{equation}
As shown by \cite{knuth}, this bound is optimal for comparison sorts.
\section{Conclusion}
Merge sort is a safe default when stability matters.
